translation.whichAreaDoYouWantToInspect: Which Area Do You Want To Inspect?
translation.name: Name
translation.youCanOnlyInspectInspectionOpenedAndAcce: You can only inspect inspections opened and accepted
translation.textConfirmFinishInspection: Finish this collection? After that its data can no longer be edited.
translation.textConfirmDeleteInspection: Delete this collection? Everything registered in it will be lost.
translation.selectTheSizeOfRadiusOfSampling: Select the size of radius of sampling
translation.thereAreNotAnySamplingCreated: There are not any sampling created
translation.textConfirmDeleteSampling: Delete this sampling and its trees?
translation.overviewDescription: Its objective is to evaluate the number of trees over 1 m in height and 3 cm in diameter found in the selected area, as well as their species diversity.
translation.treesResultDescription: The number of trees, palm trees and other plants over 1m high and 3cm in diameter found in the regeneration area. Only plants managed or planted by the regenerator must be counted.
translation.biodiversityResultDescription: The number of different species of trees, palm trees and other plants over 1m high and 3cm in diameter found in the regeneration area. Only plants managed or planted by the regenerator must be counted.
translation.reportDescription: As you fill in the data, an automated report with the justification for the result found will be created automatically and will be available for download.
translation.howWouldYouLikeCollectData: How would you like to collect the data?
translation.descHowWouldYouLikeCollectData: In the manual method, trees need to be inserted one by one, which is recommended for small areas. In the sampling method, samples are collected and the total result is estimated, which is recommended for large areas.
translation.numberOfTreesInTheSampling: Number of trees in the sampling
translation.descWeNeedYourGPSPermission: To carry out the inspection, it is necessary to access your location in real time, to ensure the collection of coordinates when registering the items.
translation.helpGivePermission: If nothing happens when you tap the button, go to your device's settings -> apps -> Syntropy -> Permissions. And enable the location permission.
translation.youAreOutsideTheCollectionArea: You are outside the collection area
translation.subtitle: Subtitle
translation.descWeNeedYourCameraPermission: During the inspection it is necessary to take some photos with your camera.
translation.helpGiveCameraPermission: If nothing happens when you tap the button, go to your device's settings -> apps -> Syntropy -> Permissions. And enable the camera permission.

tutorialScreen.trees: Count trees, palm trees and other plants over 1 m high and 3 cm in diameter. In sampling mode, walk into a sampling circle and tap “+ Tree” for each one.
tutorialScreen.species: Tap “+ Species” for each different species planted or managed by the regenerator, anywhere in the area.
tutorialScreen.photos: Take a photo with the regenerator and at least 3 photos of the area. The collection can only be finished with them.
